note: LEGACY V2 COMPATIBILITY eval archive. Requests and assertions that name POST /verify, verdict, engineOutcome, replayHash, officialAttestationHash or keyId exercise the historical v2 contract; they are not the current receipt-v1 customer recipe. Current signed integrations use POST /receipt/v1, /receipt-v1-test-vector.json and raven-receipt-verifier with an independently authenticated signer pin. Expected behaviors, not marketing claims. Auth-required tests need an invited API key; never embed keys in clients.

evals.verification_rule: verdict === 'risk' AND all expected findingCodes present AND signature verifies against an independently pinned signer key
